resources.string: Locations belong to this app. Register a directory after a successful authenticated listing in Files. Cross-app discovery and handoff are not available yet.

This prepares this location for sharing with %1$s. A future handoff would disclose only its name and a reference, never its account, directory or credentials. Cross-app discovery and handoff are not available in this build. Sharing cannot be undone; revoke permanently retires the location.

This exact location will no longer open or be shared. Its inactive record remains saved. Any session using this registered location will be disconnected. Ordinary standalone Files sessions remain independent. Register again after a new authenticated listing to obtain a new location.
The initial directory is a navigation destination, not a sandbox or a guarantee that the server path still exists.
This location is permanently revoked. Its original identity and bindings are retained.
Opening uses this exact account and starting directory. Sign in again with your password to browse; no password is saved with this location.
Locations are unavailable. Refresh to try a new read.
No saved locations. Register a directory from a successful Files listing.
Committed locations refreshed. Review the current record before any new action; no previous operation was replayed.
Sharing state saved. Cross-app discovery and handoff remain unavailable.
Location revoked. Its record is retained.
A previous operation may have completed. Refresh to inspect committed locations before deciding what to do next. Nothing will be retried automatically.
Another operation is busy. No automatic retry was started.
The location or its profile or accepted key changed, or the request is no longer current. Refresh and review before a new action.
This location cannot advance its revision. No reset or replacement was attempted.
The owning app could not access or validate its locations. Existing records were not reset.
The previous screen could not be restored. Saved locations will be reloaded; no previous action will be repeated.
Opening the private Files screen was requested. Authentication and directory listing have not completed.
The Files screen could not be opened. The one-use selection will not be retried automatically.
